title: Synergistic experimental and computational investigation of azo-linked porphyrin-based porous organic polymers for CO2 capture
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,13774-13785
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08113G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Barbara Panić, Tea Frey, Mladen Borovina, Petra Ištoković, Ivan Kodrin, Ivana Biljan
Azo-linked porphyrin-based porous organic polymers with and without linkers between tetraphenylporphyrin units were synthesized, showing enhanced CO2 adsorption capabilities in 2D layered and 3D topologies.
